credit_lines: Some days call for a workout. Others, a night out. Directed this one for Škoda around that exact tension - be driven, be spontaneous, be both. The biggest challenge was pulling off moving split screens with matching split cars, getting both halves to sync in motion. Have a look at the director’s cut result 👀
